preconditions.description: Both input sequences must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: all(char in seq1 for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the returned subsequence must be present in the first sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(char in seq2 for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the returned subsequence must be present in the second sequence.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in set(itertools.product(*[seq1, seq2])) if all(subseq[i] <= subseq[i+1] for i in range(len(subseq)-1)))
postconditions.description: The length of the returned subsequence must be the maximum length of any common subsequence between the two sequences.
